## cdaa7a006471

**Finding A2 — the tie branch is stated by the rule but excluded from every production draw.** `_nearest_unique` rejects all equal-nearest-border cases, while the authoritative rule says a tie keeps the blob's original color. The exact 10×12 input in `checks/audit/cdaa7a006471/input.json` places a color-5 2×2 blob in the top-left corner, tying top and left. It passes the current `self_check`. The authoritative Racket output retains color 5, while the plausible rival “choose the first minimum in top/bottom/left/right order” recolors it to 1. Full grids, hashes, and commands are in `checks/audit/cdaa7a006471/counterexample.json` and `checks/audit/cdaa7a006471/racket.json`.

Because production explicitly excludes ties, generated lessons cannot distinguish this rival even though tie behavior is part of the documented rule. The combined audit check found no task-local tests and failed the semantic gate because no semantic contract is declared (`checks/audit/cdaa7a006471-combined/`). I did not modify this audit target.
